title: Semi-automatic Generation of Multilingual Datasets for Stance Detection in Twitter
reasoning: The paper uses an existing benchmark dataset (SemEval 2016) which includes 'Atheism' as one of its five topics for stance detection. This is a minor part of the overall experimental setup and is used to evaluate the performance of stance detection models. The core research of the paper is about a methodology for dataset creation and does not focus on evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
